checkpoint: last epoch25 only, no validation selection
head: common symmetric query-dot-product plus log-distance bias
position: same sinusoidal features and same synthetic coords projection for all
rwkv: Nezha RWKVCellLite, cap=None, two bidirectional blocks, chunk32 prefix recurrence, time_decay clamped[-12,0], no pretrained weights
egnn: two dense equivariant graph blocks with synthetic positions(cos i,sin i,i/128), all valid off-diagonal edges, invariant radial readout; no experimental coordinates

speed_benchmark.device: cuda:0, after all training jobs exit
speed_benchmark.inference: GPU network plus separately end-to-end CPU greedy decode
speed_benchmark.memory: PyTorch peak allocated and peak reserved, includes model/input and optimizer in training

limits: 88 training and10 development validation RNAs/7 validation groups; old test is exposed and not loaded.
Small custom implementations, fixed short training budget, no architecture-wide or SOTA claim.
RWKV-Lite is not full published RWKV or optimized official fused CUDA kernels.
EGNN seed coordinates encode sequence position, not known/predicted RNA3D; no 3D-refinement conclusion.
Parameter counts match within1%, context/receptive fields and FLOPs differ.
Shared NxN pairing head remains quadratic even for a linear-recurrent encoder.
Benchmark synthetic shapes are for performance only, not prediction-quality evaluation.
